about: Hand-written spec for which crash beacons report someone else's code: browser extensions, third-party scripts we load but don't ship (each one matched as an exact https://<host>/ prefix), userscripts, muted cross-origin scripts. server/src/telemetry.rs judges every case as its handler does, through clamp_field (control characters turned into spaces); src/core/telemetry/crashReport.test.ts judges it twice, as written (the client's newline-joined stack) and flattened that same way, since the client must reach the proxy's verdict from either. 'frames' is frameOrigin / frame_origin; 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' are isForeignCodeError / is_foreign_code_error for that kind. Every other kind is never foreign, for any of these stacks. The verdicts ARE the policy: edit this file first, then both implementations, and never regenerate it from either one. See AGENTS.md, 'A crash beacon must be *our* crash before it may page'.
